title: Miki — Pixel Cursor Skill
note: Miki turned herself into a pixel-art cursor character from one selfie. The little character replaces the cursor and reacts to real interface events: sips tea while you think, points at links, pouts at buttons you can't click. It ships as a skill: one selfie in, a cursor with 14 moods. Her version: a hand-drawn mini-you or pigeon cursor on About/Play, reacting to real states on her site. Skill page: https://feizheng96.github.io/pixel-cursor/
